args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). The
vulnerability is fixed in 2.9.4, so this bumps the pin to 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the pinned `fastjson` dependency from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate CVE-2026-31337.

## Details
- CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected: fastjson < 2.9.4 (and 3.0.x < 3.1.0). Fixed in 2.9.4.
- We stay on the 2.x line and bump to the fixed 2.9.4; no other dependencies are touched.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed at commit c8b8ab7878.
